neighbours.label: the split stems ' theat' and ' theolog' (theatrically, theatrics, theologians) and French 'Théâtre'; not the whole-word tokens ' theatre' or ' theology'
fire: The lawyer sighed theatrically and dropped his papers on the desk.
She rolled her eyes theatrically when her brother began to sing.
The coach had no patience for the striker's theatrics after every tackle.
Early Christian theologians argued about the wording of the creed.
The council invited a Lutheran theologian to speak on the subject.
Several Jewish and Muslim theologians contributed essays to the volume.
La troupe jouera ce soir au Théâtre de la Ville devant une salle comble.
Elle travaille depuis dix ans comme costumière dans un petit théâtre de Lyon.
quiet: The lawyer sighed loudly and dropped his papers on the desk.
She went to the theatre when her brother began to sing there.
The coach had no patience for the striker's complaints after every tackle.
Early Christian bishops argued about the wording of the creed.
The council invited a professor of theology to speak on the subject.
Several Jewish and Muslim scholars contributed essays to the volume.
La troupe jouera ce soir à l'Opéra de la Ville devant une salle comble.
Elle travaille depuis dix ans comme costumière dans un petit cinéma de Lyon.

notes: Card: ' theolog' x6, ' theat' x4, 'é' of Théâtre x4. Probes: theatrically 0.57, theologians 0.52, théâtre 0.39; whole tokens ' theatre' 0.11, ' theology' 0.07, ' theory' 0.05. The near misses use the whole-word tokens on purpose. The opposite pole is ' Dom'/' dom', so this looks like a spelling unit, not a meaning.
